name: qlrisk_price_securities_borrowing
title: Price a SecuritiesBorrowing
description:
Price one Securities Borrowing Transaction (qlrisk SecuritiesBorrowing).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, borrowed_securities, collateral_type=cash, collateral_value=0, collateral_haircut_pct, rebate_rate_bp=-25, margin_ratio=1.02, minimum_margin=1, is_term=false, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, day_count.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV -10,308.72 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
